details.description: Illuminate your home or office with these energy-efficient LED bulbs built to suit your room size and decor. Take a break and enjoy the stream of instant bright light pouring down on you by these LED bulbs which will enlighten your surroundings.

Syska Lumispread Led Tube Lamp Features up to 90% energy saving and a wide operating voltage. Very low heating, 180-degree swivel motion and unidirectional features ensures a power-packed experience. This tube lamp can be widely used at homes, offices, restaurants, etc, up to 90% energy saving, lasts long (up to 50,000* hrs), has wide operating voltage, has very low heating, is eco-friendly, no mercury, no lead, unidirectional, swivel body action, AC220-240v/50hz, non-di mmable

Now get instant light when the electricity goes out with Syska LED Emergency Light Bulb. With retro B22 base, it can be used as a regular bulb to light up your space. Packed with a 2000 mAh battery, this bulb i mmediately lights up in case of an electricity outage. Use for emergency purpose. It has lower consumption of electricity and is energy saving. It has no UV radiation and is eco-friendly.

Too lazy to turn on or turn off your light? Syska Smart Bulb has got your back. It comes equipped with features such as Voice Control and WiFi Compatibility so that you can control the light with just your voice. Wifi-enabled, With the alarm clock feature in this smart bulb, you can easily set daily schedules.  
Syska smart bulb works perfectly well with any WiFi router without a need for a separate hub or paid subscription service. Your existing WiFi is enough (2. 4 GHz only). It works well with a wireless connection. It has 16 million colour options as it offers you 16 million shades(Warm White/ Neutral White/Natural White) and different tones to make any occasion extra special and allow to change colours as per your mood.
